competencyTargets.label: Plan water supply and allocation under hydrologic uncertainty
Characterize groundwater systems and protect drinking water sources
Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems
Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions
Assess stream channel form and function in the field
Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results
Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field
Develop pollutant load allocations and watershed restoration plans for impaired waters
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks
Analyze and interpret climate observations and projections for management decisions
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products

topTasks.statement: Prepare a drought contingency plan with triggers, stages and response actions tied to supply indicators
Run an aquifer test on a supply well or wellfield to estimate transmissivity and storage from drawdown and recovery data
Delineate a wellhead or source-water protection area from hydrogeologic data and time-of-travel criteria
Simulate ecosystem response to alternative land-use and climate scenarios, documenting scenario assumptions and the sensitivity of results to each.
Forecast water demand and supply under drought and climate scenarios for a utility or basin plan, stating assumptions and uncertainty
Compare conjunctive-use, reuse and storage options by yield, cost and reliability for an integrated resource plan
Review a well construction or injection well application against construction and protection standards before approval
Build a predictive model of fire risk, pest outbreak or water availability, validating it on years or areas withheld from fitting.
Forecast resource management needs from a validated predictive model, stating the horizon and interval for each estimate.
Survey channel cross-sections, longitudinal profile and substrate at a reach following the geomorphic assessment protocol
Identify bankfull indicators and channel evolution stage at a reach from field evidence
Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
